6.325 rsPreviousInLookupDestinationOrResult
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsPreviousInLookupDestinationOrResult is a critical error that will occur when an expression within the
Destination or Result function parameter of a Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup function uses a
Previous aggregate function.
